text:
jia: Quick idea — add a compact econ pill to the model list: tokens, cache credits, est $/1k, tiny sparkline for last 1h.

matt: 👍 as long as we don't hit ClickHouse per page load.

anya: show normalized cost by default, raw counts on hover. include a confidence badge for sampled telemetry.

infra-bot: FYI model_burn_agg rollup=5s; sampling_rate varies 0.05–0.2 by tenant.

sara: also flag quota-limited windows; otherwise tokens look artificially low. router can emit quota_event counters we can join on.

jia: API sketch: GET /internal/console/v1/model_econ?tenant=...&model=...&window=1h -> model, tokens, cache_saved_tokens, cost_per_1k_usd, sample_fraction, quota_limited. Keep payload tiny.

matt: populate via streaming upserts from CH -> Redis (hash keyed by tenant+model), TTL 30s. Console backend reads once per user session and server-renders the pill to avoid fanout. Debounce 30s. Enforce per-tenant read quotas.

anya: accessibility: confidence indicator must not rely on color only (use pattern + color). UX: gray low-confidence rows and show tooltip: "estimate based on x% sampled telemetry".

sara: reconcile plan: nightly batch job writes authoritative costs to billing store; console card links to invoice view for audit.

jia: rollout: internal preview opt-in. track expand CTR, low-confidence rate, and errors.

deploy-bot: deploy queued: feature/compact-econ-pill -> staging 2026-03-27T12:00:00Z

jia: next steps: i'll draft RFC; matt will prototype endpoint + streaming job; anya will mock UI states (good sample / low sample / quota-limited). :thumbsup:
